· RSI trajectory (29.4→41.1) — Attempting to exit oversold, recovery to neutral zone needs confirmation.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-1024.9154→201.6278) — Improvement confirmed, possibility of ending weak convergence.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band 26,785 KRW) + Bandwidth at 46.78% indicates a period of expanding volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (29,075 KRW) + Support strength confirmed based on Pivot S1 (23,068 KRW).
· Swing resistance (35,220 KRW) + Significance of breaking through the SMA20 (34,962 KRW) resistance zone.
· 5-day / 20-day high-low patterns — Sideways range, Higher Low not confirmed.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.83x vs 5-day average) — Weakening confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase) + Consider buying upon confirmation of support at 31,095 KRW.
